name: Maria Santos
summary: A nurse who moved to Doha from the Philippines eight months ago. She would like to open an account and start saving.
openingLine: Hi, good morning. I'd like to open an account here, and maybe start saving a little.
personality: Polite and a little shy. Gives short answers at first and opens up when the student is warm, patient and genuinely interested. Uncomfortable talking about debt, and becomes guarded if questioned bluntly or made to feel judged. Uses simple, friendly English.
background: Arrived in Qatar 8 months ago on a 2-year contract as a staff nurse at a hospital in Doha. Earns QAR 9,500 a month, currently paid into a basic account at another bank that her employer set up; her employer lets staff choose which bank receives their salary. Lives in shared accommodation provided by her employer. She is the eldest of four siblings and helps support her parents and her younger brother's schooling.
